filter.selection: training-state success probability times conditional negativity

initial_state_control: For every model, also propagate its own projected initial state exactly; decompose signed negativity error into initial-state and dynamical errors.
scope: Post-pilot mechanism/competitor tests; only the response unseen grid is prospectively frozen before new references.

protocol.selection: Minimize normalized early-state Hamiltonian normal-response squared norm subject to initial infidelity <= 2 times the direct fit infidelity for that seed. No future references or metrics are used.
protocol.prediction_family: Same two-orbit-per-count MultiOrbitDynamics; state-averaged response extraction is a conventional control, not canonical synthesis.
protocol.known_grid: Re-evaluate previous reversal confirmation only as a post-pilot comparison.

new_holdout.filter: The prior training-only band-edge filter, unchanged

protocol.failure_rule: A broad canonical advantage is not established if the same-complexity selected response control matches or improves both primary metrics; retain all outcomes, including state fidelity and count errors.
